title: Argentinian Smoked Roasted Meal Bowl
description: A hearty and flavorful Argentinian-inspired meal bowl featuring roasted chicken and vegetables, with a smoky twist.
instructions: Season the chicken breasts with smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Place the chicken on a baking sheet and roast for 25-30 minutes, or until cooked through.
Toss the chopped red bell pepper and onion with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Spread on a baking sheet.
Roast the vegetables in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
Toss the chopped potatoes with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Spread on a baking sheet.
Roast the potatoes in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
To assemble the meal bowls, place a portion of roasted chicken, vegetables, and potatoes in a bowl.
